messages:
alex: CI alert - p99 generation jumped ~45% on h100-us-east after merge r4621. e2e-latency and kvcache-smoke failing. suspect kernel selection + kvscheduler churn. cc @mira @sam

mira: which job? link pls

alex: https://ci.internal/redwood/neurally/4621-build/987 - see artifacts + flamegraphs attached in the job

sam: i saw a smaller bump on A10 yesterday, but H100 spike is much larger. initial glance shows bursts on NIC transmit around heavy kv-evict windows. grabbing flamegraphs now

jo: deploy-bot posted: "merge r4621 by @carla: kvscheduler: prefer compact kernel for short sequences and adjust prefill/batch heuristics"

mira: that PR touched kernel_selector heuristics and prefill timing. my hunch: when preferring compact kernel for seq_len <= 16, we change KV cache warmup -> causes more frequent kv eviction/reprefill which floods NIC with small packets leading to transmit queue stall on some H100 host NICs

alex: snippet from the flame (reduced):
```
flamegraph: hot: kernel_selector::select_compact -> kv_scheduler::evict_if_needed -> net::tx_submit -> net::tx_retry
p99 segments show repeated net::tx_retry spikes each 20-40ms
```

linh: i can repro locally on h100-emulator with a perf-random workload if i force kernel_variant=compact. p99 goes up ~30% when kv_eviction_threshold set to 0.7 vs 0.9

sam: quick benchmark i ran (seq=8, batch=4):
```
# baseline (kernel=v1-balanced)
p50 12ms p95 28ms p99 45ms
# with r4621 kernel=compact-pref
p50 14ms p95 44ms p99 67ms
```

carla: fwiw PR changed two things: prioritization logic in kernel_picker and prefill kick timing in kvscheduler. I didn't touch NIC code. happy to bisect further or revert if needed

mira: plan suggestion: 1) revert kernel prioritization part of r4621 (candidate PR 4629 created by @carla) 2) run quick canary routing to steer h100-us-east traffic to kernel:v1-balanced 3) run targeted CI job with perf probes to confirm

ops-bot: canary rollback scheduled for h100-us-east pool at 2026-03-18T15:45:00Z (manual approval required) :warning:

alex: created postmortem ticket INF-1245 and assigned. adding flamegraphs + perf traces.

sam: additional note: L4/A10 hosts only show this when burst co-tenancy is >60%. H100 hosts appear more sensitive to small-packet egress bursts (driver queue depth). looks like a noisy-neighbor amplification of kv churn

linh: i'll run a controlled bisect: toggle kernel_picker preference + prefill timing independently to isolate which change amplifies net bursts. will post results in ~45m

mira: TY. if the bisect points to prefill timing, we might add a short jitter to prefill to smooth tx patterns asap. if it's kernel selection, revert is safer for rollout unblock.

carla: opened revert PR 4630 that reverts kernel prioritization only. leaving prefill tweak for separate follow-up so we can test.

deploy-bot: PR 4630 opened by @carla -> https://git.internal/redwood/runs/4630. Label: rollback-candidate

alex: good. once canary shows p99 back to baseline i'll approve full rollback. else we'll need to revert whole r4621.

mira: logging note: adding extra perf counters for net tx queue depth + kv evict count to the canary job to make root cause explicit.

sam: also adding a quick microbench that simulates 50% co-tenancy burst to exercise noisy neighbor pattern on CI nodes

linh: bisect update: initial run points strongly at prefill timing change increasing eviction churn when combined with compact kernel preference. reproducer attached in job 991

alex: thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the rollback and bisect. will update INF-1245 with final verdict and mitigation notes.
